remarks: 19 Circle Road is located near the end of a quiet, private street, backing-up on three sides into the serene and tranquil Selleck's Woods Nature Preserve. An updated five-bedroom home offers a thoughtful floorplan, privacy, and convenience just minutes to downtown Darien. The large eat-in-kitchen by DEANE is the heart of the home, opening to a bright sunroom with peaceful wooded views. The flexible layout includes a first floor bedroom with full bath, ideal for guests or a home office. A gracious living and dining room with wet bar creates an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs features a spacious primary suite plus three additional bedrooms with balcony overlooking the backyard. A generous laundry room finishes the second floor. The oversized family room above the garage is filled with natural light and conveniently located off of the eat-in kitchen. With three full baths, one half bath, a full basement for storage, and a walk-up third floor with expansion potential, this home offers both comfort and future opportunity. Enjoy the rare combination of privacy backing to nature while being moments from everything Darien has to offer.
